findings.id: independent canonical check and broader item4 search (kernel, exploratory)
findings.label: same-author exact finite evidence; NOT yet pinned as a file
findings.content: Wrote an independent canonical RIGHTSN check. B_can is computed as the quotient of the free RIGHTSN band on 4 letters (748 elements; the letters were identified as the only elements with no nontrivial factorization) by the C2-invariant congruence generated by all source-host equations. On the 14-element source it reproduces the 44-element canonical band and finds no R-pair collapse. A new search covered 2-generated regular, pure, RRL subsemigroups of P(B,D) with same-fibre R-pairs, for: B in {B5, B5^1, RB22^1 under row-, column- and both-swap, LZ2^1, LZ3^1, LZ2^0^1}, all non-RIGHTSN with involutive automorphisms; and D in {D8, three C2 actors of shape 3x3 or 3x2 with nontrivial minors}. It found 560 qualifying sources: 200 over D8, 120 for each of the other three actors, with 30 or 40 per band-actor pair. Zero collapses. The LZ families produced no qualifying sources.
findings.limit: Only 2-generated sources with C2 labels; all inside small physical hosts over non-RIGHTSN bands. Supports item4 but does not prove it.
findings.next: Save as a standalone script with results JSON and pin.

findings.content: (i) RIGHTSN is not local in the semigroupoid sense. Regularity must be used; condition (C), aba=ba for a=ex and b=ey same-fibre idempotents, holds in every RRL source. (ii) S45 is the full Rees source M[(RZ2⋊C2)^1;3,3;P] and so is covered by the 2026-10-28 Rees evaluation-band theorem over its natural actor plus pushforward. (iii) Candidate general route: refine the actor until same-fibre L-pairs fall in different fibres, then use a Rees evaluation band over a right-regular core, then push forward. Its crux is a Rees-matrix embedding of RRL sources; untested.

blocker: No general construction for item4 yet. The bottom-up and top-down inductions each need upper/lower layers to anticipate one another.
next_action: Pin the search script and results; file the locality/regularity note; test the Rees-embedding/actor-refinement route on the group-top family.
status: Original Q1/Q2 OPEN; nothing adopted; no novelty/formal claim
